title: Hosanna Hosanna
lyrics_original: I see the King of glory
Coming on the clouds with fire
The whole earth shakes – The whole earth shakes
I see His love and mercy
Washing over all our sin
he people Sing – The people sing
Hosanna, Hosanna – Hosanna in the Highest
Hosanna, Hosanna – Hosanna in the Highest
I see a generation
Rising up to take the place
With selfless faith, with selfless faith
I see a near revival
Staring as we pray and seek
We're on our knees, we're on our knees     || Hosanna ||
Heal my heart and make it clean
Open up my eyes to the things unseen
Show me how to love like You have loved me
Break my heart for what breaks Yours
Everything I am for Your Kingdom's cause
As I walk from earth in – to eternity        || Hosanna ||

bible_verses.telugu: జనసమూహములలో ఆయనకు ముందు వెళ్లుచుండినవారును వెనుక వచ్చుచుండిన వారును  దావీదు కుమారునికి జయము1ప్రభువు పేరట వచ్చువాడు స్తుతింపబడునుగాక సర్వోన్నతమైన స్థలములలో జయము1అని కేకలు వేయుచుండిరి.
bible_verses.english: The crowds that went ahead of him and those that followed shouted, 'Hosanna to the Son of David!' 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!' 'Hosanna in the highest heaven!'

bible_verses.telugu: అప్పుడు మనుష్యకుమారుని సూచన ఆకాశ   మందు కనబడును. అప్పుడు మనుష్య కుమారుడు ప్రభా వముతోను మహా మహిమతోను ఆకాశ మేఘారూఢుడై   వచ్చుట చూచి, భూమిమీదను
bible_verses.english: Then will appear the sign of the Son of Man in heaven. And then all the peoples of the earth will mourn when they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా, దయచేసి నన్ను రక్షించుము యెహోవా, దయచేసి అభివృద్ధి కలిగించుము. యెహోవాపేరట వచ్చువాడు ఆశీర్వాద మొందును గాక యెహోవా మందిరములోనుండి మిమ్ము దీవించు చున్నాము.
bible_verses.english: Lord, save us! Lord, grant us success! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord. From the house of the Lord we bless you.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, King of glory, I welcome Your powerful presence into my life today. Thank You for Your unending love and mercy that cleanses me from every sin. Open my eyes to see Your majesty, and tune my heart to sing Your praises with joy. Use me as part of a generation that rises up to love You and serve others faithfully. Hosanna in the highest!
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, King of glory, I welcome Your powerful presence into my life today. Thank You for Your unending love and mercy that cleanses me from every sin. Open my eyes to see Your majesty, and tune my heart to sing Your praises with joy. Use me as part of a generation that rises up to love You and serve others faithfully. Hosanna in the highest!
devotional.reflection_english: When we lift our voices to sing "Hosanna," we join a timeless chorus declaring Jesus as our glorious King and Savior. The song reminds us that His overwhelming love and mercy wash away our sins, softening our hearts and shaking the foundations of our lives. As we behold His majesty, we are invited to surrender everything and step into the generation He is raising up. Let your heart be renewed today as you fix your eyes on His glorious presence.
